hypotheses: People can distinguish a shared AI twin from its human owner.
People can name what their twin knows and what requires confirmation.
A useful rehearsal builds more trust than an automatic claim of perfect personality matching.
People understand the difference between a reel script and a rendered video.
tasks: Create a private twin using only the supplied fictional facts.
Ask the twin to commit to Friday and explain why the answer needs confirmation.
Generate a discussion with one AI partner and identify every AI participant.
Create and export a reel script, then locate the sharing control.

acceptanceTargetsNotResults.taskCompletionWithoutHelp: at least 4 of 5 people per task

reportRules: Separate simulated predictions from observed behavior.
Do not claim virality or retention from this small study.
